description: Composition of three composable relations is associative.
signature:
Relation.comp_assoc.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {δ : Type u_4} {r : α → β → Prop}
  {p : β → γ → Prop} {q : γ → δ → Prop} : Relation.Comp (Relation.Comp r p) q = Relation.Comp r (Relation.Comp p q)
